name: ettawa-web-workspace
description: Root workspace untuk menjalankan modul Fronted, Backend, dan AI secara bersamaan di local mode

scripts.dev: npx concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "cd ai && .venv\Scripts\python main.py"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend && cd ai && pip install -r requirements.txt
